Kerala Government Orders Probe into Failed Messi Visit Arrangements

Kerala's Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan announced a probe into the arrangements for a planned visit by Argentinian football star Lionel Messi and the national team to Kochi. A preliminary inquiry by the Sports Department has indicated "very serious allegations" of irregularities, including issues with sponsor selection and potential GST evasion. The Chief Minister stated that multiple departments and agencies will conduct further investigations into the matter, which he described as a "betrayal" of the public. The opposition has called for a court-monitored audit.
